desc: 炭黑配安全黄工业体系，空参数轨与留白适配板承接选型信息
leaf: 活性炭车厢空调滤芯双片装
name: 活性炭双片空调滤芯套装款

shots.intent: 在搜索结果缩略图里一眼赢下点击，交代双片滤芯加工具的整套含量。
用三支留白尺寸箭头的规格屏消除尺寸疑虑，数值由卖家自填。
用黄框本品牌卡对黑卡他方的对垒版式，把多层过滤优势讲成一眼对比。
用立于炭堆上的滤芯与炭粒圆窗微距证明活性炭层的真实材质。
用三步选车流程的留白面板教买家自查适配，降低买错退货。
用渐变色带上的空白适配清单行与交叉参考栏，让卖家填入自家车型谱。
把滤芯放进一家出行的真实车厢，用绿意气流可视化清新空气。
用滤芯滑入手套箱后槽位的实拍步骤打消安装门槛顾虑。
收口促单，用双芯、素盒与工具的一次到位阵型给出下单理由。

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent industrial charcoal and safety-yellow auto consumable ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of charcoal board #17181A, safety yellow #E8C400, filter grey #9AA0A6 and carbon black #2B2B2D on a cool white #FFFFFF base; hard clean product light near 6000K throwing crisp rib shadows along the pleats with thin yellow rim accents on boards and warm daylight spill inside cabin frames; white sweep, matte charcoal boards, carbon mound terrain confined to one macro and cabin bokeh confined to two in-car frames, no wood, no linen; one heavy industrial sans kept as empty placeholder rails; thin white circle icons with yellow rings, blank check and cross discs, one Vs medallion; plain charcoal box with a single yellow band and no wordmark; no color palette changes, no readable codes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting.
noDrift: no readable OE or competitor codes
no brand wordmarks on box or boards
style.presentationRules: filters always show clean grey pleat faces with white frame edges, tools stay unbranded single pieces, the box is plain charcoal with one yellow band and no wordmark, people in cabin frames are generic and cropped or shot from behind
